method: One warmup endpoint pair followed by five rotated rounds per tool; each endpoint timed separately with Python perf_counter around GNU time -v. Builds and tests stopped. Separate identical Git-written fixtures. Binaries copied to fresh files before sampling.
verification: For every tool/fixture: 300 visible files and 700 sparse rows (10,000 visible files/index rows for full10k), clean Git status and successful git fsck --strict after reset and switch.

fixture_shapes.sparse120k: 120000 tracked; 300 visible; 400 excluded directories; 300 visible edits
fixture_shapes.sparse240k: 240000 tracked; 300 visible; 400 excluded directories; 300 visible edits
fixture_shapes.unique120k_changed5000: 120000 tracked; 300 visible; unique excluded blobs; 300 visible and 5000 excluded edits
fixture_shapes.full10k: 10000 tracked and visible; sparse checkout disabled; 300 edits
